desc: Implement the DSU class with `find` and `union` methods
Filter `nums` to separate valid values ($\le$ `threshold`) and invalid values ($>$ `threshold`)
Initialize the DSU structure with valid values and create a boolean array `exists` to mark presence of valid numbers up to `threshold`
Iterate $M$ from 1 to `threshold`, find multiples $k \cdot M \le$ `threshold`, and union all found valid numbers
Count unique roots in DSU for valid numbers and add count of invalid numbers to get the final result
Verify the solution with provided examples and finalize the code
